sql_templates.description: Latest enhanced report metrics and filtered stocks for last 5 sessions.
sql_templates.template:
WITH recent_runs AS (SELECT * FROM report.enhanced_runs WHERE run_ts >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days'),
latest_filtered_stocks AS (
    SELECT efs.*
    FROM report.enhanced_filtered_stocks efs
    INNER JOIN recent_runs rr ON efs.run_id = rr.run_id
    ORDER BY rr.run_ts DESC
)
SELECT rr.run_id, rr.run_ts, rr.universe_size, rr.stocks_analyzed, rr.stocks_filtered,
       efs.symbol, efs.score, efs.recommendation, efs.current_price
FROM recent_runs rr
LEFT JOIN latest_filtered_stocks efs ON rr.run_id = efs.run_id;
